title: ASI Terminology Inference
description: Schema for current-snapshot terminology proposals produced by TerminologyInferrer workflows.

candidateId.description: Stable ID for this terminology inference. Suggested form: ti:<DOC_ID>:<normalizedKey>.

candidateType.description: Type of terminology proposal. TerminologyInferrer proposes; Supervisor or later approved workflows decide acceptance.

oneOf.description: Term may be worth adding to the canonical source because the source strongly implies the concept but lacks compact stable wording.
Term is useful for ASI search/routing but should not become canonical source terminology by default.
Phrase may be useful as a stable X-is-not-Y boundary wording.
Phrase may be useful as a stable name for a relation between documents, terms, concepts, or authority areas.
Proposed heading or label to add to source only after approval; it is not an invented ASI source locator.
Term appears misleading, unsupported, too implementation-specific, or should be replaced by better wording.

sourcePresence.description: How the proposed term appears or does not appear in the canonical source.

oneOf.description: The proposed term appears literally in the source.
The source uses a close spelling or wording variant.
The exact term is absent, but the source strongly defines or implies the concept.
The exact term is absent and support is weak or speculative.
The term is not supported by the source and should normally be rejected or replaced.

recommendedAction.description: Recommended next workflow action. This is not final acceptance unless a supervisor decision records it elsewhere.

oneOf.description: Send to Supervisor or user for acceptance, rejection, or refinement.
Recommended as ASI-only alias if accepted; does not imply source terminology.
May deserve source wording change, but this is not source-patch approval.
Recommended for rejection.
Postpone decision until more source, audit, or cross-document context exists.

suggestedIndexUse.description: Possible index use if accepted by the appropriate decision workflow.

oneOf.description: No suggested index use.
Use as ASI alias or search synonym.
Use as literal term lookup card.
Use as context-specific term meaning card.
Use as boundary card.
Use as relation card.

flags.description: Structured attention flags. Empty array means no special handling is currently requested beyond the recommendation itself.

sectionHint.description: CMR-native section, rule, paragraph, or range reference when available. Do not use this as an invented ASI anchor.

oneOf.description: Strongly supported by source or accepted workflow evidence.
Reasonably supported but may need later review or cross-document confirmation.
Weak or tentative support; use cautiously.
Requires audit, supervisor review, or stronger source evidence before relying on it.
Requires supervisor/user judgment before affected downstream use. May be emitted by any ASI workflow. Handled by Supervisor.
Meaning likely depends on comparison with other documents. Emitted by Extractor, BatchAuditor, TerminologyInferrer, or Indexer. Handled by BatchAuditor or CrossBatchAuditor.
Canonical source may need clearer wording, a missing boundary, compact term, or better source heading. Handled by Supervisor first; SourcePatcher only acts after explicit approval.
May need a better name, ASI alias, boundary phrase, relation name, or source-term proposal. Handled by TerminologyInferrer.
Plausible but weakly grounded in source. Handled by BatchAuditor, CrossBatchAuditor, Indexer, or Supervisor if final routing would depend on it.
Same literal key appears in more than one context and may not mean the same thing. Default handling is split, not merge, unless audit/supervisor decision says otherwise.
Affected output cannot proceed because a required audit, cross-batch, or supervisor decision is unresolved. Handled by Supervisor or the workflow owning the missing decision.
